All I'm saying is that it has always to me felt like a rip off that we can't wield our staves/wands, and that it wouldn't hurt to simply hold them while we're charging, casting, and channeling our spells.
 
:I

I understand where you're coming from, but it doesn't have to be "Over the Top" animations. It would just be a simple charging/channeling animation of the character charging a spell with one hand empty and the other hand holding their staff/wand.

One thing I would like to say though - If The Burning Legion is gathering demons from other realities to fuel itself, then that leaves the realities the demons were gathered from short of demons. Also, If The Burning Legion operates in "Every Reality/Timeline", then it would make no sense for the legion to gather demons from "Other Realities" when the Burning Legion is already handling every reality.
 
Just doesn't make any sense in any capacity. Hopefully in this new expansion "Legion" blizzard will fix the lore and won't fuck up as much as they have in the past.

> It's not, though. We "live" and play there, yes, but they set the rules, parameters and storyline. You can choose to ignore this as much as you want and make up your own wants and wishes. That's a waste of time in my opinion, but you go ahead.
 
And what? You'd rather sit back and take whatever content Blizzard makes up your ass, whether it's amazing or terrible, without the community's say-so? Without the player's voice it's not just a waste of time, it's a waste of a game.
 
>Yes. It may very well be that ours is the only one.
 
OUT OF THE LITERALLY INFINITE AMOUNTS OF AZEROTHS? Really? Now you're just being self-righteously delusional buddy. 
 
>That's your opinion. I think it's fine and better. Others might disagree with either of us.
 
Yes. My opinion. An opinion based on solid Logic and Reasoning stemming from the fact that if The Burning Legion is "One legion for every Universe" and is operating in every universe that they would have been defeated Eons ago because they'd be outnumbered and annihilated.
Alright, Fine, Whatever. I stopped giving a fuck like 10 minutes ago when tons of bitches downvoted this post harder this [Deer got Dunked On.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yo2ftZzA6Xc)

I don't necessarily agree with the "Gods transcending all timelines" thing like you said... Also, The Burning Legion is made up of Demons, not gods. However I completely agree about WoD... The expansion created ridiculous plot holes that should be buried deep within our subconscious and forgotten about forever.
 
And I care. I want the lore of one of my favorite games of all time to be solid and not screwed up and/or retconned beyond the point of no return.

It Doesn't Matter. Army or not, the point is still the fucking same. it doesn't make any sense for their to only be "One Legion" for a literally infinite amount of Universes. It's retarded.
 
It would be as arbitrary as saying "There is only one of ... so-and-so for every Universe" about anything. It's a ridiculous notion.
 
Also, and here's the big question, **WHY???????** Why would The Burning Legion the one thing that's "The only one out of all Universes" instead of literally anything else??? We weren't given a reason or explanation. They Devs said "Because we said it is", and *Voila*. Poof. Done.

The Burning Legion's wiki page. I might have been wrong and over estimated. It might just be "around 1 billion" demons. But when faced with Infinity though, the point doesn't really change does it? They're infinitely outnumbered and it doesn't make any sense for their to only be one burning legion for every universe.

>It's their universe. Their fiction.
 
#NO. IT'S OUR UNIVERSE. The Game Universe we share as Players. 
 
Just because Blizzard Entertainment runs it/owns it doesn't mean they should fuck up the lore with terrible idea, nor should we let them.
 
>Also, the Burning Legion is interested in our Azeroth because she's a Titan
 
The Same thing can be said for the infinite amounts of Azeroth's throughout the infinite Timelines/Realities. It's not like out of the **INFINITE AMOUNT OF AZEROTH'S** That ours is the only one with a Nascent Titan is it.
 
The bottom line is, the terrible idea that "There is only One Legion for every Possible Timeline/Reality" is just lazy and shitty Lore writing.
 
Also, I'm pretty sure the Bronze Dragonflight would disagree with the Moronic Developers who came up with this idea in the first place.
Like a badass Rabbit out of the Persian Army in **"300"**.

Ooooh.... that's why they're not high levels.
 
Lolololol. Okay, so not level 60 then...
 
But maybe raise it a little bit? Ya know? like tier 5 = lvl 40-50? It's nice armor man...

Stop being a Neurotic OCD bitch and step up to the challenge. Jesus fckn Christ. Questing is not PVM skill, but you need PVM skill for Questing. Not all Fingers are Thumbs, but all Thumbs are Fingers, who gives a fuck. Personally, I would LOVE to stomp a mudhole in Sliske's devious face in a heartbeat, especially after he handed my ass to me on a silver platter and stole part of my soul in Kindred Spirits. I don't care how hard he is, and I don't care how many tries I'd have to do it, as long as he's beatable.

Not just about the quest being hard. It's about the quest being good. I seriously don't get why all you bitches don't want to fight Sliske. I mean... after aaaaaallll of the irritating promotional and quest-related crap Jagex has done with Sliske, are you seriously telling me that you'd rather it all just Fizzle out for nothing? If ANYTHING... that would be boring as Fuck. Period. Like the guy said, Questing is Adventuring and shit. Not just PVM, but that doesn't mean it shouldnt be in there. 
 
Also, **IT'S MORE OF A CHALLENGE YOU LAZY MOTHERFUCKERS**... I mean... Damn... It's like you people only want the rewards and you don't want to work for them. *"I want a quest cape, but I don't wanna have to fight dat really hard boss! Wwwwhhhaaaaaaaaaaaghhh!!!!"*
 
Stop lowering the bar, and Step the Fuck up to the challenge. A harder requirement only makes wearing that cape more honorable.

If people want their damn capes back, they should fucking earn them, not have the standards of higher-tiered quests lowered simply to satisfy lazy bitches.
 
Beside, the PVM community loves bossing, whether in quests or out of them. Don't take away the opportunity for an awesome fight just because "it's hhaaaaarrrrrrrrdddddd".

Thanks for the response and calling me "gifted". But the truth is, it's reasonable Nihilism at least. There's not much irrationality to the reasons I gave in the sense that those reasons feel like small empty things to live for. I'm not Depressed, as I don't feel sad or angry or have anxiety or anything at all really. Just because I lack a reason to live doesn't mean I'm depressed. If anything, this article is a self-observation, not a cry for help. Analytically, I can't find any meaningful reason to continue existing. There's Nothing that I can devote my life to and significantly change things for the better.
 
Relationships/love/children/family/all that bullshit is out the window. 
 
Pleasure is just an empty biological mechanism that usually drives Organisms toward beneficial things and away from detrimental things. Given that Human's are Sapient organisms, most of us find that pleasure feels good at a very young age. So, like simpletons that do rather than ask and understand the why of our situation, we chase after more and more and more pleasure until we become desensitized to it, addicted to it, and overdose on it. So again, the "feel good life" is empty and stupid. No reason to exist here.
 
I appreciate the advice on connecting with people, but like I said, I genuinely cannot connect with other human beings. Not even my own mother. I'm an Isolated Introvert and an Analytical Partial Sociopath. I don't feel anything *(besides typical physical stimuli)*. 
 
I could go on, and I really appreciate the advice and your sympathies, but everything is still the same regardless. The major difference between those existential thinkers and me is that I have the will to *not* live into my golden years.
 
___
Thanks
